scenes.en: Common, but know when it is urgent.
scenes.say: Blurry vision during pregnancy? It is common. But know when it is urgent.

scenes.en: Hormones and extra body fluid can slightly change the shape of the cornea.
scenes.ta: ஹார்மோன், உடல் நீர் மாற்றம் கருவிழியை மாற்றலாம்
scenes.say: Here is why. Pregnancy hormones and extra fluid in the body can slightly change the shape and thickness of the cornea, the clear front window of the eye.

scenes.en: Dry, gritty eyes. Contact lenses may feel uncomfortable.
scenes.say: Dry, gritty eyes are also common. Contact lenses may suddenly feel uncomfortable.

scenes.en: Mild changes usually settle after delivery and breastfeeding.
scenes.say: Did you know? These mild changes usually settle a few weeks after delivery and breastfeeding. So many eye doctors suggest waiting before changing your glasses power.

scenes.en: Sudden blur, flashing lights, spots, or double vision, with headache or swelling
scenes.ta: திடீர் மங்கல், ஒளி மின்னல், தலைவலி: உடனே மருத்துவரிடம்!
scenes.say: But sudden blur, flashing lights, spots, or double vision, especially with headache or swelling, can be a sign of high blood pressure. Call your doctor immediately.

scenes.en: Rest your eyes. Blink often. Switch to glasses if lenses hurt. Tell your doctor about any change.
scenes.say: Rest your eyes often, blink more, switch to glasses if lenses hurt, and tell your doctor about any change in vision.

scenes.en: Book an eye test after delivery, or anytime you are unsure.
scenes.say: Not sure about your eyes? Book an eye test.
